bio.name: Abraar Jihaad Hibatullah
bio.title: Computer Science Graduate | iOS & Machine Learning Developer
bio.bio: Computer Science graduate with real-world project experience through Bangkit Academy by Google and Apple Developer Academy. Hands-on with Python, TensorFlow, and Keras for machine learning; Swift for iOS development; and JavaScript/Node.js with REST APIs and CI/CD for full-stack web development.

projects.title: K-sini: Indoor Navigation iOS App
projects.description: Indoor navigation app for train stations, built in a cross-functional team at Apple Developer Academy. GeoJSON-driven multi-floor mapping rendered as layered MapKit overlays, BFS shortest-path routing, and compass-guided directional haptic feedback for eyes-free navigation.

projects.title: Kriptoin: Crypto Trading Simulation App
projects.description: Risk-free cryptocurrency trading simulation built with Flutter. Real-time market data from the CoinGecko API with a Hive-based caching layer, SHA-256 password hashing with fingerprint biometric login, and 7 coordinated Provider state managers across features.

projects.title: PixPlay: Cloud-Based Music Player
projects.description: Full-stack music player — React frontend and an Express.js REST API (MVC) with Sequelize over MySQL, JWT authentication with refresh-token cookies, and an automated Cloud Build CI/CD pipeline deploying Docker images to Cloud Run.

projects.title: ML for Earthquake Classification — Undergraduate Thesis
projects.description: End-to-end ML pipeline over 2,800+ seismic events: ObsPy waveform processing, a CNN autoencoder with a custom multi-domain loss as an unsupervised feature extractor, and an XGBoost classifier — improving accuracy from 90% to 98%.

projects.title: SIGAP: AI News Analysis Web App
projects.description: FastAPI backend with web scrapers (BeautifulSoup, Selenium) collecting Indonesian news portals into an SQLite database via SQLAlchemy, and an LLM pipeline using locally hosted Llama 3.2 (Ollama) that summarizes and generates solutions for every article — 1,000+ articles monthly.

projects.title: Air Quality Analysis
projects.description: Comprehensive data visualization and patterns extraction for the Beijing Station air quality parameters.

experience.description: A nine-month program run by Apple and BINUS that teaches iOS development based on a research and development process. Working in cross-functional teams to design, build, and ship real apps.

Built the backend of SIGAP, a web-based news scraping system with LLM-powered analysis — FastAPI REST endpoints, scrapers covering four Indonesian news portals, and a locally hosted Llama 3.2 (Ollama) pipeline that summarizes and classifies 1,000+ articles monthly, improving analysis speed from hours to minutes.

A Google-led academy designed to produce tech talent for Indonesia, focused on Machine Learning, Mobile Development, and Cloud Computing. Built machine learning pipelines using TensorFlow and Keras. Graduated with Distinction, ranked among the top 10% of the cohort.

experience.role: Team Leader, Quality & Customer Experience — AIESEC Future Leaders
experience.description: Led the Quality & Customer Experience team for AIESEC Future Leaders. Increased project profitability by 75% over a 12-month period, exceeding initial forecasts, and managed customer relations with an average satisfaction score of 9.7 out of 10.
